label: toleranceExclusive: a value exactly the tolerance away no longer snaps
oneBucket: a lookup reads only floor(v / 64), so a line across a bucket edge is missed
find: guard reach >= 0, let low = Self.bucket(v - reach), let high = Self.bucket(v + reach) else { return [] }
replace: guard reach >= 0, let low = Self.bucket(v), let high = Self.bucket(v) else { return [] }

label: noCentre: lines(on:) leaves out the box's centre
